subject: GCP Marketplace listing: procurement, compliance & commercial routing
messages:
From: Alex Park <ops@helio.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@helio.io
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: GCP Marketplace listing: procurement & resell routing

Hi Marissa / Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're ready to move forward with a GCP Marketplace listing but need to align on procurement flow and commercial routing. A few specific questions from our side: 

- What does the purchase path look like for customers who want to buy via GCP billing vs. direct invoice?
- How do you handle resell/co-sell routing and invoice attribution when a partner (like us) is listed?
- Any required contract language (PO terms, indemnities, data residency) we should surface early to speed legal review?

Our procurement team (procurement@helio.io) would like a short checklist and an estimate of the time-to-live for activation once we provide the PO and SKU mapping. Also: who should we expect to see in DocuSign for any marketplace addenda?

Can you share a concise mutual action plan and the minimum artifacts you need from our side?

Appreciate it — Alex

--
Alex Park
Head of Platform Operations | Helio Inc
ops@helio.io
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: GCP Marketplace listing: procurement & resell routing

Team — forwarding Helio's ask. Quick plan below; will loop legal when we need redlines. Please review and add anything urgent.

Snapshot plan (high priority):
1) Deliver a one-pager checklist for Helio (billing options, required PO fields, typical DocuSign signatories). Attach: gcp_activation_cheat_sheet.pdf (draft).
2) Prepare resell/reseller routing note. Ben, please confirm how account attribution works if the customer buys through GCP vs. via Helio invoice.
3) SKU mapping: Naomi, can you own the mapping template and mock-up (they'll send our mapping & we confirm GCP SKU config)?
4) Legal gating: set expectation that we need a signed addendum for co-sell/resell terms. Karthik, flag any non-standard clauses we should preapprove.
5) Timeline estimate: once PO + SKU mapping + signed addendum are in, typical activation (internal provisioning + Marketplace verification) 7-12 business days (assuming no Google escrow/billing hold).

Attachments: gcp_activation_cheat_sheet.pdf, resell_terms_summary.docx

Ask: everyone reply with quick confirmation by EOD so I can send Helio the consolidated MAP and artifacts.

Thanks — Marissa
Director, Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: GCP Marketplace listing: procurement & resell routing

Marissa — quick notes from commercial operations:

- Attribution: If a customer purchases via GCP billing, GCP handles the invoice and we receive settlement per the marketplace terms (there's a delay due to GCP payout cadence). For reseller/invoice purchases routed via Helio, Redwood invoices Helio under the reseller agreement, and Helio invoices the end customer.
- Billing contact: we should ask Helio to provide a billing/contact PO email (they listed procurement@helio.io — good).
- Pricing: ask Helio to confirm whether they want a unified public SKU price or two SKUs (one for GCP-billed, one for reseller pricing). Two SKUs reduces reconciliation friction but requires extra SKU setup.

Legal note: the resell_terms_summary.docx highlights that we require an addendum that: clarifies split of support responsibilities, sets minimum liability caps, and enumerates data handling expectations. For co-sell vs resell routing, the addendum toggles responsibilities.

I'll draft a short paragraph explaining attribution and recommended SKU approach.

Ben
Senior Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Park <ops@helio.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: legal-team@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP Marketplace listing: procurement & resell routing

Alex — thanks for the clear list. Attaching a mutual action plan (MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_helio_redwood.xlsx) and a short paragraph on DocuSign flow and signatories. Highlights below: 

- DocuSign & Legal: addendum will be executed between Redwood Inference and Helio. Typical signatories: Redwood VP Partnerships / Helio Head of Legal + procurement PO contact for billing terms. We can prep a DocuSign powerform link; I've included a sample DocuSign reference.
- Required artifacts from Helio: completed SKU mapping template, PO (or confirmation they will use GCP billing), contact for billing reconciliation, and any customer-facing reseller language they require.
- Google gating: marketplace verification occasionally asks for a commercial contact and sample invoice — we can provide the sample. If GCP flags the listing for additional compliance review (rare), it may add 5-7 business days.

Links: HubSpot record for Helio (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/HelioInc) and a Drive folder with templates (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBExampleDriveLink).

Next steps proposed:
1) I will send Helio the MAP, the two attachment templates, and request a preferred pricing routing (single SKU vs dual SKU).
2) Once they confirm, Naomi will finalize SKU mapping and Ben will set commercial reconciliation instructions.
3) We queue legal for the addendum; once signed, we request GCP activation.

Karthik
Head of GTM Partnerships | Redwood Inference
From: Alex Park <ops@helio.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>

Marissa / Karthik — thanks for the quick turnaround and the MAP you sent. Procurement confirms they will send a PO to procurement@redwoodinference.com by Friday. A few quick confirmations from our side: 

- We prefer the two-SKU approach (GCP-billed SKU + reseller SKU) to keep internal billing and margins clear.
- Procurement will complete the SKU template this week and attach a sample PO.
- Helio legal says the standard addendum language is acceptable; they expect to execute via DocuSign and will use the link you provide.
- We also need sandbox account details for a short smoke test prior to activation — can you provide a limited-duration sandbox project/token for Helio's integration engineers?

I'll copy procurement on the PO once it's out. Appreciate the clarity and the checklist — Alex

Alex Park
